description: Fork of exp134 (E=64 saturated 468M) trimming tph to the information-theoretic 2*N*log2(N) coverage target. Pair samples per head: qk/v 768 (=2*64*6), out_proj 2913 (=2*192*7.585). Same nap=8 (table_dim=256, 4x n_outputs headroom). Per-head weights: qk 1.57M, v 0.79M, out 5.96M. Per-layer LUT 20.13M, 6 layers 120.8M LUT + ~15M = ~135M params. Tests whether the lean-coverage regime matches or beats exp134's saturated regime — same dims (E=64), 3.5x fewer LUT weights.
